name: Battlecry Ballad
author: voodoo573
description:
Level 3 abjuration spell from Level Up: Advanced 5th Edition. You fill your allies with a thirst for glory and battle using your triumphant rallying cry. Expend and roll a Bardic Inspiration die to determine the number of rounds you can maintain concentration on this spell (minimum 1 round). Each target gains a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of rounds you have maintained concentration on this spell (maximum +4).

You cannot cast another spell through your spellcasting focus while concentrating on this spell.
summary: 3rd-level bard song: allies gain growing attack and damage bonuses each round.

data.name: Battlecry Ballad
data.desc:
Targets: any number of creatures within range. You fill your allies with a thirst for glory and battle using your triumphant rallying cry. Expend and roll a Bardic Inspiration die to determine the number of rounds you can maintain concentration on this spell (minimum 1 round). Each target gains a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of rounds you have maintained concentration on this spell (maximum +4).

You cannot cast another spell through your spellcasting focus while concentrating on this spell.

At higher levels: You can maintain concentration on this spell for an additional round for each slot level above 3rd.
